summary: Implemented the Decathalon datalist loader. Added monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py with load_decathalon_datalist and a private _resolve_path helper; exported it from monai/data/__init__.py; added a "Decathalon DataLoader" autofunction subsection under Utilities in docs/source/data.rst; added tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with TestLoadDecathalonDatalist covering the four required cases. Nothing was committed, and tests, black, and flake8 were not run per instructions. Line lengths were measured manually (max 116 in the loader, 92 in the tests), so black formatting is unverified. Choices beyond the spec: non-object top-level JSON and non-list key values raise ValueError; output items are new dicts; no extra error-path tests were added.
